_: Link previews built by the sender (SPEC 19.87; collective-belfry docs/link-previews-v2.md). Written by belfry-android (tools/link_previews_vectors.py); web and iOS copy it byte for byte. Sections: links (which link of a text gets a preview: the composer's rule), html (a page's text and final address -> title / description / site / picture address; og, then twitter, then <title> / meta description, piece by piece; values: tags stripped, entities decoded, whitespace collapsed, cut to 200 / 300 / 100 Unicode code points then trailing spaces trimmed; the picture made absolute against the final address, https only), charsets (bytes + Content-Type -> title), urls (may the sender's device fetch it), addresses (may it connect to a name that resolved to this; every address of a name must pass), pictures (the type by the first bytes, hex), tags (what a message carries: the preview tag and its imeta entry, plain and AES-256-GCM encrypted with a fixed key and nonce, as files of direct messages: vectors/dm-files.json), read (a message's text and tags -> the box a reader shows, or null; the picture only from the belfry's Blossom).
